look_here_first: Inspect flowers SIDE-ON and measure the narrow corolla tube: 6–9(–10) mm. A. longiflora is (20–)28–41(–45) mm. Check sepals (0.8–1.8(–2) mm), leaves and eventual follicles. Do not assign var. texana from species-only records.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Upright perennial herb with leafy stems.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Simple narrow leaves; inspect nodes and leaf margins for hairs.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Five-lobed salverform flowers; tube 6–9(–10) mm; sepals 0.8–1.8(–2) mm.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Paired narrow follicles; confirm from mature specimens.
